title: Loneliness (and Boredom)
bodyHtml:
Hey human.

Us cats have to wait when humans go to work.
It gets boring. It gets quiet. Sometimes it feels lonely.

But here’s the thing, we don’t stew in it.

  • - I take a nap.
  • - I watch the birds.
  • - I chase dust bunnies.
  • - I remind myself: boredom beats chaos.

When I’m restless, I find little things to do.
Make a soft spot to nap, find a silly toy or a cozy window view.

You can too: read a book, work on a puzzle, go for a walk.

Loneliness is just a pause.
Not forever. Not broken.
Just between snuggles.
